name: Hotspot
author: rawritude
description: Share this laptop's Wi-Fi uplink with a phone, without dropping the uplink. Built for one-device networks — planes, hotels, conference Wi-Fi — where the laptop holds the paid session and the phone joins a local AP NAT'd out through it. A toggle and a password field; the SSID and password persist so a phone that has joined once reconnects on its own.

barWidget.description: Share the current Wi-Fi uplink with a phone; the uplink stays connected.
